dct_description_sm: Mapping the distribution and abundance of Tundra Swans and their nests within 0.5 km of the road system in Greater Prudhoe Bay.  Tundra swans are known as a focal species for study due to their tendency to return to the same breeding area location each year, the relative ease of identification during aerial surveys, and because we believe the Tundra Swan would help us assess the overall health of the water bird communities that visit our oil fields.
dct_title_s: Tundra Swan Monitoring in Greater Prudhoe Bay, Alaska
